members.name: banking77
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Pick exactly one.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card they have received, or a problem activating it.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account or use the service; whether children/teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay, Apple Watch or Android Pay with the account/card, including topping up through them.
criteria.atm_support: Where to find ATMs or which ATMs accept the card; using the card at an ATM in general.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up: setting it up, how it works, turning it off, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money transferred INTO the customer's own account (e.g. a transfer from their UK account / other bank account, or money sent to them) has not shown up in their balance yet, or the balance is slow to update after a transfer, or they want to check such a transfer went alright (e.g. 'why is it taking so long to update my balance transfer?', 'how long does a transfer from a UK account take? I just made one and it isn't showing up').
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Money they deposited (a cash or cheque deposit, or an unspecified 'deposit') has not shown up, is slow to clear/appear, or the balance has not updated after depositing it.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a payee/beneficiary, or a beneficiary is not allowed/rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer or transaction they made (by mistake).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring soon or has expired; getting a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; which shops/retailers take it; card not accepted somewhere.
criteria.card_arrival: The card they ordered hasn't arrived yet; tracking their card delivery.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes in general; express delivery; delivery time to a country.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or re-linking a card to the app/account; adding a card they found or already have to the app.
criteria.card_not_working: Card is not working / has stopped working / is broken, without naming a shop, merchant or place where a payment was refused (e.g. 'my card is not working when I try to use it').
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Was charged an extra fee for a card payment / purchase.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment, purchase, charge or payment on their account/app/statement that they don't recognise, didn't make or didn't authorise (other than a direct debit, a cash withdrawal or a small odd extra fee); e.g. 'a payment on my statement is wrong', 'there is an unknown charge on my account'.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment/purchase abroad, or an error with the exchange rate they were charged (e.g. 'there's an error with the rate that is charged').
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM/cash machine kept, swallowed or ate their card (the ATM must be involved).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash from an ATM.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Cash withdrawal on the account they didn't make / don't recognise.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset their PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Suspect card details were stolen or compromised, someone else may be using their card, or they want to report possible fraud / fraudulent activity on their account (e.g. 'how do I report possible fraudulent activity on my account?').
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service/card is available or supported in; using the account while living abroad; also a bare 'Can I get support?'.
criteria.declined_card_payment: Card payment was declined, or the card did not work / was refused at a shop, restaurant, merchant or other named place(s) where they tried to pay.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM declined their cash withdrawal / couldn't withdraw cash.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer they tried to make was declined.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account they don't recognise.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits of disposable virtual cards, e.g. how many times one can be used.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number, email.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or cost of exchanging currency; charges on currency exchange; whether frequent exchangers can get a discounted/better rate or lower exchange fees.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used; how exchange rates are determined; current rates.
criteria.exchange_via_app: Converting money from one currency to another using the app: how to do it, whether they can exchange X for Y in the app (e.g. 'can I exchange USD for GBP in your app?', 'I need euros for my holiday, can I exchange my money?'), or problems completing an exchange.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small odd extra amount on the statement, typically an extra £1/1 euro/1 dollar charge or an unexplained extra fee, even if they say they don't recognise it or it shows as pending. A general unknown, wrong or unauthorised charge/payment with no small extra amount is NOT this (that is card_payment_not_recognised).
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed / didn't go through, including a large payment such as for a house/flat purchase or mortgage that shows an error.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported / available for holding or exchanging; whether a particular currency or region's currency is offered (e.g. 'are you able to make exchanges to EUR?', 'can I exchange currency to Europe?', 'which currencies can I hold?').
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable virtual card; what they are.
criteria.get_physical_card: Has received / is setting up their physical card, e.g. where to find the PIN for the new card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare/second card, e.g. for family members.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a (non-disposable) virtual card; cost of a virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card is lost or stolen, they want to freeze/block their card immediately (no fraud mentioned), or they need help to retrieve / get back their card (e.g. 'can you help me retrieve my card?'), when no ATM kept it.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone is lost or stolen; can't access app because phone is gone.
criteria.order_physical_card: How or where to get or order a physical plastic card; cost of a card; ordering a card to a country.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot app passcode/password; resetting the passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is showing as pending, or a payment (not explicitly a transfer) hasn't gone through / completed yet and is still processing.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending / hasn't completed yet, or they topped up and can't see the funds yet or aren't certain it has gone through yet (e.g. 'why can't I see my funds after I topped up?', 'I'm not certain my top-up went through yet').
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is explicitly described as pending; how long transfers stay pending.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked / card blocked after entering wrong PIN too many times; unblocking the PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / get paid into the account; receiving salary or transfers from others; whether they need to add / can have their salary paid in (e.g. 'do I need to add my salary?').
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund they were promised hasn't appeared in their account.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request/get a refund for an item or service, or asks about refund process.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment to a merchant/seller was reverted, returned or reversed, e.g. money was deducted then came back, or the seller says the payment didn't go through.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard/Amex) and currencies are supported for topping up or payments.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer (the customer explicitly mentions a bank transfer).
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up / adding money with a card, or a fee for adding money when the method is not specified.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: How or whether they can add money with cash or a cheque (not a delay with a deposit already made).
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up (sometimes misspelled, e.g. 'pop-up') failed, was declined, or it is not working (e.g. 'I'm not sure if my pop-up went through') / something went wrong with it (e.g. 'is something wrong with my top-up? I can't access my money'), without a card-specific problem. Not when the top-up was made and the funds just aren't visible yet (that is pending_top_up).
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how many, how often.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (money added to their own account) was reverted, cancelled or taken back.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Topping up with a card: how to do it, or a card top-up where the money was taken/gone but did not arrive in the balance.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Same transaction charged twice / duplicate charge.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer or for sending money / banking abroad; also when the customer frames the fee complaint as a transfer fee (e.g. 'I thought transfers were free') even if it involved a purchase.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into their own account / top up by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: An outgoing transfer the customer already sent to a named recipient (a friend, a retailer, another person's account, within the country) hasn't arrived or isn't showing up for them; or the customer asks WHY their transfer/transaction hasn't gone through or completed yet / is taking so long (e.g. 'why hasn't my in-country transfer gone through yet?', 'why is my transaction taking so long to complete?', 'I've waited 2 days for my transfer to reach a retailer's account').
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive, or how much longer they have to wait for their transfer (e.g. 'it's been a couple of days, how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?'), when no recipient is named and they don't say it is stuck or missing.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Problems verifying identity; verification failing or not working.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for identity verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying the source of funds; why they need to show where money came from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used to top up; why a top-up needs verification; can't find/see the verification code for a top-up or card transfer.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing or asking for a card of a specific network (e.g. 'I want a Visa card').
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed, or whether they can use the account without verifying their identity.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied on a cash withdrawal abroad.

declined_cash_withdrawal.use when: ATM declined their cash withdrawal / couldn't withdraw cash.

declined_transfer.use when: A transfer they tried to make was declined.

direct_debit_payment_not_recognised.use when: A direct debit on the account they don't recognise.

disposable_card_limits.use when: Limits of disposable virtual cards, e.g. how many times one can be used.

edit_personal_details.use when: Changing personal details: name, address, phone number, email.

exchange_charge.use when: Fees or cost of exchanging currency; charges on currency exchange; whether frequent exchangers can get a discounted/better rate or lower exchange fees.

exchange_rate.use when: What exchange rate is used; how exchange rates are determined; current rates.

exchange_via_app.use when: Converting money from one currency to another using the app: how to do it, whether they can exchange X for Y in the app (e.g. 'can I exchange USD for GBP in your app?', 'I need euros for my holiday, can I exchange my money?'), or problems completing an exchange.

extra_charge_on_statement.use when: A small odd extra amount on the statement, typically an extra £1/1 euro/1 dollar charge or an unexplained extra fee, even if they say they don't recognise it or it shows as pending. A general unknown, wrong or unauthorised charge/payment with no small extra amount is NOT this (that is card_payment_not_recognised).

failed_transfer.use when: A transfer failed / didn't go through, including a large payment such as for a house/flat purchase or mortgage that shows an error.

fiat_currency_support.use when: Which fiat currencies are supported / available for holding or exchanging; whether a particular currency or region's currency is offered (e.g. 'are you able to make exchanges to EUR?', 'can I exchange currency to Europe?', 'which currencies can I hold?').

get_disposable_virtual_card.use when: How to get a disposable virtual card; what they are.

get_physical_card.use when: Has received / is setting up their physical card, e.g. where to find the PIN for the new card.

getting_spare_card.use when: Getting an additional/spare/second card, e.g. for family members.

getting_virtual_card.use when: How to get a (non-disposable) virtual card; cost of a virtual card.

lost_or_stolen_card.use when: Card is lost or stolen, they want to freeze/block their card immediately (no fraud mentioned), or they need help to retrieve / get back their card (e.g. 'can you help me retrieve my card?'), when no ATM kept it.

lost_or_stolen_phone.use when: Phone is lost or stolen; can't access app because phone is gone.

order_physical_card.use when: How or where to get or order a physical plastic card; cost of a card; ordering a card to a country.

passcode_forgotten.use when: Forgot app passcode/password; resetting the passcode.

pending_card_payment.use when: A card payment is showing as pending, or a payment (not explicitly a transfer) hasn't gone through / completed yet and is still processing.

pending_cash_withdrawal.use when: A cash withdrawal is showing as pending.

pending_top_up.use when: A top-up is pending / hasn't completed yet, or they topped up and can't see the funds yet or aren't certain it has gone through yet (e.g. 'why can't I see my funds after I topped up?', 'I'm not certain my top-up went through yet').

pending_transfer.use when: A transfer is explicitly described as pending; how long transfers stay pending.

pin_blocked.use when: PIN is blocked / card blocked after entering wrong PIN too many times; unblocking the PIN.

receiving_money.use when: How to receive money / get paid into the account; receiving salary or transfers from others; whether they need to add / can have their salary paid in (e.g. 'do I need to add my salary?').

Refund_not_showing_up.use when: A refund they were promised hasn't appeared in their account.

request_refund.use when: Wants to request/get a refund for an item or service, or asks about refund process.

reverted_card_payment?.use when: A card payment to a merchant/seller was reverted, returned or reversed, e.g. money was deducted then came back, or the seller says the payment didn't go through.

supported_cards_and_currencies.use when: Which cards (Visa/Mastercard/Amex) and currencies are supported for topping up or payments.

top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.intent: top up by bank transfer charge
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge.use when: Fee for topping up by bank transfer (the customer explicitly mentions a bank transfer).

top_up_by_card_charge.use when: Fee for topping up / adding money with a card, or a fee for adding money when the method is not specified.

top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.intent: top up by cash or cheque
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque.use when: How or whether they can add money with cash or a cheque (not a delay with a deposit already made).

top_up_failed.use when: A top-up (sometimes misspelled, e.g. 'pop-up') failed, was declined, or it is not working (e.g. 'I'm not sure if my pop-up went through') / something went wrong with it (e.g. 'is something wrong with my top-up? I can't access my money'), without a card-specific problem. Not when the top-up was made and the funds just aren't visible yet (that is pending_top_up).

top_up_limits.use when: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how many, how often.

top_up_reverted.use when: A top-up (money added to their own account) was reverted, cancelled or taken back.

topping_up_by_card.use when: Topping up with a card: how to do it, or a card top-up where the money was taken/gone but did not arrive in the balance.

transaction_charged_twice.use when: Same transaction charged twice / duplicate charge.

transfer_fee_charged.use when: Charged a fee for a transfer or for sending money / banking abroad; also when the customer frames the fee complaint as a transfer fee (e.g. 'I thought transfers were free') even if it involved a purchase.

transfer_into_account.use when: How to transfer money into their own account / top up by bank transfer.

transfer_not_received_by_recipient.use when: An outgoing transfer the customer already sent to a named recipient (a friend, a retailer, another person's account, within the country) hasn't arrived or isn't showing up for them; or the customer asks WHY their transfer/transaction hasn't gone through or completed yet / is taking so long (e.g. 'why hasn't my in-country transfer gone through yet?', 'why is my transaction taking so long to complete?', 'I've waited 2 days for my transfer to reach a retailer's account').

transfer_timing.use when: How long transfers take to arrive, or how much longer they have to wait for their transfer (e.g. 'it's been a couple of days, how much longer do I have to wait for my transfer?'), when no recipient is named and they don't say it is stuck or missing.

unable_to_verify_identity.use when: Problems verifying identity; verification failing or not working.

verify_my_identity.use when: How to verify identity; what documents are needed for identity verification.

verify_source_of_funds.use when: Verifying the source of funds; why they need to show where money came from.

verify_top_up.use when: Verifying a top-up or the card used to top up; why a top-up needs verification; can't find/see the verification code for a top-up or card transfer.

visa_or_mastercard.use when: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing or asking for a card of a specific network (e.g. 'I want a Visa card').

why_verify_identity.use when: Why identity verification is needed, or whether they can use the account without verifying their identity.

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.use when: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash / less cash than requested.

wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.intent: wrong exchange rate for cash withdrawal
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal.use when: Wrong exchange rate applied on a cash withdrawal abroad.
